```{r setup-mascot_examples, include = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
studio_character <- if (exists("studio_character")) studio_character else formals(mascot::mascot)$character
```

### Pick an example by its task

The descriptions below show what each example teaches. Use the `name` column
as the value to pass when opening one with `r guide_fn_link("mascot_example")`.

```{r mascot_examples-listing, echo = FALSE}
guide_table(mascot::mascot_examples()[c("name", "title", "description")])
```

### List the names

```r
mascot::mascot_examples()
```

The listing is a plain data frame, in the order the examples are best read.
Start with the first entry, then take the scenario that matches your app.

```{r mascot_examples-host-mode, echo = FALSE, results = 'asis'}
if (in_studio()) cat("In the studio, selecting this function opens the Examples host mode: choose an example to read its code and copy its launch call.\n")
```
